items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: of course I knew Jeff through his affiliation with Wildlands and the Warriors, and I knew him more so as a player.

ctx.x: And, uh, and one of the Riddicks, of course I knew Jeff through his affiliation with Wildlands and the Warriors, and I knew him more so as a player. Yeah. He's, he's a good, well-routined New Orleans piano player.
Did you know Avery Loposa from Mobile?

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I liked Tim very, very much. He was one fine fellow.

ctx.x: And he told me about playing around East Texas and how he went on from there to do everything.
I liked Tim very, very much. He was one fine fellow. Mm-hmm. Still is. Oh, yeah. Tim was a very good friend of Peck Kelly's.
Mm-hmm. Well, they finally put out a record of Peck. I haven't heard it yet.
